articles.body: TL;DR Waze and Garmin have partnered to introduce real-time cyclist alerts that help drivers spot cyclists nearby. The feature is optional, protects cyclists’ identities and routes, and is rolling out globally on Android and iOS. If you use Waze regularly , you probably know how handy its alerts can be. articles.title: Building Keeva: Client-Side Encryption and Persistent Vault State with Tatum and Walrus Memory
articles.excerpt: A technical walkthrough of a credential vault built for the Total Recall - Tatum × Walrus Memory Hackathon. Remembering a user is not the same as securely restoring their private data. For a credentia…
articles.body: A technical walkthrough of a credential vault built for the Total Recall - Tatum × Walrus Memory Hackathon. Remembering a user is not the same as securely restoring their private data. For a credential vault, persistence raises several difficult questions: Where does encryption happen? What authorizes access? How does the application identify the correct vault after a wallet reconnects? What happens when a password changes, two devices edit the same record, or a storage request succeeds but its response never arrives? I built Keeva to explore these questions during the Total Recall - Tatum × Walrus Memory Hackathon , held from 20 October to 10 November 2026. Keeva stores passwords, API keys, and private notes as client-encrypted records.

articles.title: A Smaller Instance in the Wrong Family Is Still Waste
articles.excerpt: TL;DR: Right-sizing conversations default to "bigger or smaller," because that's what usage-history tools measure cleanly. A third category of mismatch gets skipped almost every time: wrong instance f…
articles.body: TL;DR: Right-sizing conversations default to "bigger or smaller," because that's what usage-history tools measure cleanly. A third category of mismatch gets skipped almost every time: wrong instance family , a workload whose actual resource profile (CPU-heavy, memory-heavy, I/O-heavy) doesn't match the family it's running on, regardless of size. A correctly-sized instance in the wrong family is still waste, it's just cheaper waste that passes a casual audit. A real gaming studio's database family fix shows what this looks like and why it's the hardest of the three mismatches to catch automatically.

articles.title: NASA's twin ESCAPADE Mars probes slingshot around Earth in unprecedented double 'gravity assist'
articles.excerpt: NASA's twin ESCAPADE spacecraft are wrapping up a year-long voyage to Mars, and are now ready to make a beeline to the Red Planet.
articles.body: Twin NASA spacecraft are wrapping up a year-long escapade, ready to make a beeline to the Red Planet. The Escape and Plasma Acceleration and Dynamics Explorers (ESCAPADE) spacecraft launched in November 2025 on the second-ever flight of Blue Origin's New Glenn rocket. But rather than head straight to Mars, the two spacecraft dawdled through a looping trajectory . Now, they are back in Earth's neighborhood where they tackled a crucial engine burn unusually close to Earth that — if all goes well — will set them on track for Mars . "No NASA mission has ever done this before," said Rob Lillis, a planetary and space physicist at the University of California, Berkeley and principal investigator of the ESCAPADE mission.
